text:
Zoe H: Moving apartments this weekend, clearing out a few things I can't bring: a working Anglepoise-style desk lamp (brass, some patina), two SF Giants tickets (Sat night, sec 101 row 12), and a USB-C 7-port dock (PD passthrough). Pickup SF office or I can leave at front desk. Free to a good home.

Priam: Interested in the lamp if it's truly free :) Any dents on the shade?

Zoe H: @Priam tiny ding on the shade edge, cosmetic only. Bulb included.

Faye (she/her): I'll take the dock if it's available. Need one for a new MacBook.

Zoe H: @Faye dock is yours. I'll leave it labelled at the front desk under "Faye".

Alex - Facilities: FYI: if someone needs help moving the lamp we have a hand truck and two people available. Lamp base might be heavier than it looks.

Ben: I'll take the Giants tix if still free. Can pick up after work today.

Zoe H: @Ben tickets are yours. I'll DM the PDF and leave the physicals at the front desk under "Ben".

Priam: I can swing by around 7pm to pick up the lamp. @Alex - Facilities want to meet then?

Alex - Facilities: I can meet at 6:50pm by the front desk to help move it out to your car.

office-bot: Reminder set — "Zoe: leave dock for Faye, tickets for Ben, lamp for Priam" at 2026-08-14 18:00.

Zoe H: Thanks all. Quick recap: dock -> @Faye (front desk), tickets -> @Ben (PDF + physical), lamp -> @Priam (pickup ~7pm, @Alex assisting). Will update here if anything changes. :blush:
